Twemoji Country Flags (TwemojiCountryFlags.woff2, 78 292 bytes), from the npm package country-flag-emoji-polyfill 0.1.10 (TalkJS), unchanged.
The flag pictures are Twemoji (Twitter / X), CC-BY 4.0; the package code is MIT. See LICENSE.md.
Windows has no flag emoji ("🇨🇿" shows as the letters "CZ"), so lib/flags.js adds this font there, for the flags only.
